one_sentence_story: By testing 18 scuba divers 20 feet underwater versus dry on a Scottish shore in 1975, Duncan Godden and Alan Baddeley proved free recall jumps ~46% when retrieval surroundings match learning surroundings — while their 1980 follow-up and modern replications showed multiple-choice tests, varied study rooms, and 30-second 'mental room visualization' easily overcome room changes.
so_what_for_you: Use context two smart ways: study important material in **at least two different places** so it isn't chained to one chair, and whenever your mind blanks in an exam or kitchen doorway, **mentally step back into the room where the thought formed**.
